preconditions.description: The length of the binary representation of r must be between 1 and 10^6.
The binary representations of l and r must both have a length equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in l) and all(c in '01' for c in r)
preconditions.description: The binary representations of l and r must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.
The integer value of l must be less than or equal to the integer value of r.

postconditions.description: The output must be the binary representation of the maximum XOR value of all integers from l to r.
